shots.full: Night, a bare brick back room. Camera low on the concrete floor looking up: a wooden pallet stacked higher than a man with uncut printed sheets of purple twenty-pound notes, thousands of paper edges in layers, the top sheets fanned a little and one corner curling. Only a pair of black brogues and suit trouser legs stand beside it, for scale; no faces. One hard white work lamp in a wire cage rakes across the stack from the right, catching the paper edges; the rest falls to black. Dust in the air. Unretouched 35mm film still, rich saturated colour, fine grain, a little underexposed. 16:9. Thanks.
